summary: Ballard Power Systems filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release dated October 16, 2026, announcing the timing of its Q3 2026 earnings conference call. The call is scheduled for Monday, November 16, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. Pacific (10:00 a.m. Eastern), accessible by dial-in and webcast with a replay posted to the Investor Hub. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. This is a routine investor-calendar notice, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
